identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of BL-M07D1 in Combination With Pembrolizumab in Patients With Unresectable Locally Advanced or Metastatic HER2-Overexpressing Non-Squamous NSCLC
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of BL-M07D1 in Combination With Pembrolizumab in Patients With Unresectable Locally Advanced or Metastatic HER2-Overexpressing Non-Squamous Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This trial is a multicenter, open-label, Phase II clinical study to explore the efficacy and safety of BL-M07D1 in combination with pembrolizumab in patients with locally advanced or metastatic HER2-overexpressing non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer.

armGroups.label: BL-M07D1+pembrolizumab
armGroups.description: Participants received BL-M07D1+pembrolizumab in the first cycle (3 weeks). Participants who had a clinical benefit could receive additional cycles of additional treatment. Administration will be discontinued because of disease progression or intolerable toxicity or for other reasons.

interventions.name: BL-M07D1
interventions.description: Administration by intravenous infusion for a cycle of 3 weeks.

interventions.name: Pembrolizumab
interventions.description: Administration by intravenous infusion for a cycle of 3 weeks.

primaryOutcomes.description: ORR is defined as the percentage of participants, who has a CR (disappearance of all target lesions) or PR (at least a 30% decrease in the sum of diameters of target lesions). The percentage of participants who experiences a confirmed CR or PR is according to RECIST 1.1.
The combined optimal dosage will be investigated.
The combination method will be investigated.

secondaryOutcomes.description: The PFS is defined as the time from the participant's first dose of BL-M07D1 to the first date of either disease progression or death, whichever occurs first.

The DCR is defined as the percentage of participants who has a CR, PR, or Stable Disease (SD: neither sufficient shrinkage to qualify for PR nor sufficient increase to qualify for progressive disease \[PD: at least a 20% increase in the sum of diameters of target lesions and an absolute increase of at least 5 mm. The appearance of one or more new lesions is also considered PD\]).
The DOR for a responder is defined as the time from the participant's initial objective response to the first date of either disease progression or death, whichever occurs first.
Overall survival (OS) is defined as the time between the subject's randomization date and subject's death.
Maximum serum concentration (Cmax) of BL-M07D1 will be investigated.
Time to maximum serum concentration (Tmax) of BL-M07D1 will be investigated.
Ctrough is defined as the lowest serum concentration of BL-M07D1 prior to the next dose will be administered.
Frequency of anti-BL-M07D1 antibody (ADA) will be investigated.

TEAE is defined as any unfavorable and unintended change in the structure, function, or chemistry of the body temporally emerging, or any worsening (i.e., any clinically significant adverse change in frequency and/or intensity) of a pre-existing condition during the treatment of BL-M07D1. The type, frequency and severity of TEAE will be evaluated during the treatment of BL-M07D1.
